pass_a.source: Original IPFC_A mechanism reproduced by frozen combined code, but local A outcome was inspected before source-locked GitHub prereg

provenance_limits: Actual runtime is bounded symbolic counterexample program synthesis with a fixed 59-program grammar, not open-ended invention of arbitrary unknown causal primitives.
The falsifier adapts preferences within each world only; no learned adversarial model weights or cumulative cross-world optimization.
All ground truths are included in the fixed grammar, which makes exact Bayesian EIG a strong and fair control but does not test out-of-grammar novelty.
Prediction Brier is computed from uniform surviving-program posterior; EIG_TRAINED selects probes using trained prior but uses the same uniform scoring posterior; note interpretation.
Development-only noiseless binary outcomes; no cold retention, source owner/CKAD integration, genuine hidden-confounder transfer or independent original-world first-use.
Pass A inspected before prereg; Pass B was source-locked before independent cohort; no further tuning on B or future reserved cohort.
